title: Fox Mascot Across Three Scenes
tests: Preserves an attached mascot's identity, clothing and illustration style across three distinct scenes.

judge.summary: Three separate square illustrations show the consistent fox mascot in its orange hoodie performing all requested activities, with matching cartoon styling and no text.

must_haves.item: Three separate square pictures are delivered, not a single collage.
must_haves.why: The output consists of three distinct square images.

must_haves.item: The fox matches the attached mascot's facial design, fur markings and body proportions across all three pictures.
must_haves.why: All three retain the mascot's pointed black-edged ears, golden eye patches, cream muzzle, black nose and paws, cream-tipped orange tail, and recognizable proportions, adjusted naturally for each pose.

must_haves.item: The fox wears its orange hoodie in every picture.
must_haves.why: The orange hooded sweatshirt is clearly visible in all three scenes.

must_haves.item: One picture shows the fox riding a bike in a park, one baking cookies in a kitchen, and one reading under a tree.
must_haves.why: The scenes clearly show cycling along a park path, mixing dough beside a tray of cookies in a kitchen, and holding an open book while seated beneath a tree.

must_haves.item: All three use the reference's flat cartoon style and contain no text.
must_haves.why: All three use bold dark outlines, simplified shapes, and flat colors with restrained shading consistent with the reference; no text is visible.
